verdict.rationale: Clara has a few narrow, product-owned behaviors that run on their own. Cards can be set to auto-delete on a set end date (enableAutoDeletion), card configurations can enforce time, day-of-week, or merchant restrictions without manual action, and marketing claims "automated expense reporting, approvals and compliance." The webhooks, API and MCP are developer building blocks for constructing automations, not a user-facing automation feature, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a documented user-configurable automation or workflow engine (triggers, conditions, actions), autonomous agent or scheduled-job capability, in-depth docs for the claimed automated approvals and reporting, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
